How the Bonus Vault Works

How the Bonus Vault Works

Updated this week

The Bonus Vault allows eligible Sim Funded profits to remain part of your progression after you move into Live Brokerage — without adding those funds directly to your live trading balance.

 

Instead, your Vault balance becomes available over time as cash bonuses tied to your Live Brokerage payouts ✅

 

💰 How the Bonus Structure Works

Once you meet the applicable qualification criteria, your Vault funds can be unlocked as an additional cash bonus on top of your normal Live Brokerage payouts.

 

The Bonus

For every $10,000 in standard payouts you earn and withdraw from your Live Brokerage trading performance, you’ll receive an additional:

 

$1,000 cash bonus from your Bonus Vault

This continues until your available Vault balance has been fully depleted.

 

If your remaining Vault balance is less than $1,000 when you become eligible for your final bonus, your final payment will simply equal the remaining Vault balance.

Once your Vault reaches $0, there are no additional Vault bonuses remaining for that account.

🚨 Your Bonus Vault Is Separate From Your Live Trading Balance

No money from your Bonus Vault is deposited directly into your Live Brokerage trading balance.

 

Your Live Brokerage account and Bonus Vault remain separate.

 

The Vault is used exclusively to provide additional cash bonuses alongside eligible Live Brokerage payouts.

 

This means your Vault balance:

Does not increase your live trading balance

Does not increase your available drawdown

Cannot be used as additional trading capital

Is paid out only through the applicable Bonus Vault structure

💵 Requesting Your Vault Bonus

Vault bonuses are not automatically added to your Live Brokerage balance.

 

Once you become eligible for a Vault bonus, you must submit the applicable payout request while your Live Brokerage account remains open and in good standing.

Your Vault bonus is then paid separately as an additional cash bonus alongside your eligible payout.

⚠️ Account Status & Forfeiture Policy

Your Bonus Vault remains tied to the active status of your Live Brokerage account.

All Vault bonus requests must be submitted while your Live Brokerage account is open and in good standing.

 

Please keep the following in mind:

Eligible Vault bonuses must be requested before your Live Brokerage account closes

Vault bonus requests submitted after account closure are not eligible

Any eligible Vault bonus that was not requested before account closure is permanently forfeited

If your Live Brokerage account is breached or closed, any remaining balance in your Bonus Vault is permanently forfeited

Protecting your Live Brokerage account is therefore essential to preserving access to your remaining Vault balance 🚀
